estimate.no_interval: one replication: the figures are point estimates with no interval, so the randomness of the workload is not covered

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 512: vLLM main's default (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes and _split_cudagraph_capture_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2465-2870 at 0fda86a), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes: the interface default: one shared token ladder up to 512 (CudaPlatformBase.get_cudagraph_capture_defaults, vllm/platforms/cuda.py:640-652); a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: moe_routing
assumptions.Scope: : the experts class vLLM resolves for mixed routed experts (moe_backend "marlin") is not resolved here, so no selection launch is counted

assumptions.Name: encoder
assumptions.Scope: priced as a substitution: the tower is priced with the decoder's GEMM efficiency ramp (BF16) and its measured prefill-attention rate, bidirectional and with no KV cache; no allowed data measures an encoder step, so every point with an encode step is capped, and the tower's collectives and fused kernels are not priced

assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: an fp32 router gate above 32 tokens runs F.linear on the fp32 weight (gate_linear.py:116-136), SGEMM on CUDA cores at the datasheet FP32 rate since VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION defaults to highest (envs.py:92), on the BF16 ramp

assumptions.Name: all_reduce_message_limit
assumptions.Scope: the custom lane for every message size: the engine runs a message above the custom kernel's size limit on NCCL; the pool's tensor-parallel all-reduce is priced from the custom lane at every size (inference-sim/inference-sim#2478)

assumptions.Name: nontorch_in_budget_bytes_8rank
assumptions.Scope: 0: no fit-unit group measures the non-torch memory vLLM grows inside the KV budget for this model and part (non_kv_cache_memory, gpu_worker.py:720-756@v0.33.0), so none is charged and the KV budget is overstated by it

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.34.0+0fda86a35419 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)
